ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patch situated in the medial and lateral regions of the right lobe; fragmented, mottled white clusters concentrated in the medial region of the left lobe; dominant low-intensity black pigmentation framing the entire trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 120 degrees and minimal pixel-depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with irregular pixel amplitudes (5-12 pixels) along the continuous boundary; prominent jaggedness and non-uniform peaks present across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the posterior edge with an acute upward sweep towards the terminal distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (scarring) visible on the right distal tip and along the lower-left trailing edge margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear streaks (rake-like marks) disrupting the white pigmentation field on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular missing tissue segments and secondary notches along the trailing edge, indicating mechanical trauma or persistent wear.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast 'dripping' effect where black pigmentation extends into the white field on the interior right lobe.
